# Module M-10: Settle the morning's exceptions list

## Lesson

You do this at the start of each day, before new orders arrive. When it works, every line on the list is settled and moves to the order sheet or is marked for the customer. [SC-10]

## Exercise

In the test environment, with its test data:

1. Open the exceptions list at the start of the day. [SC-10 step 1]
2. Settle each line: correct the code or note it for the customer. [SC-10 step 2]

Came up in testing: UAT-01.

## Check question

What do you do when it goes wrong?

## Answer

A line you cannot settle stays on the list; ask the operations manager. [map/future.md item 2]
